key_insight: AI-assisted thermoreflectance imaging can help map local thermal properties and visualize heat transport shaped by interfaces and defects in nanostructures.
engineering_relevance: Spatially resolved thermal characterization can guide materials discovery and thermal management in miniaturized, heterogeneous electronics.
method: Review non-contact pump–probe thermoreflectance imaging and scanning.
Survey AI-assisted data processing, interfacial transport visualization, and subsurface analysis.
Outline heat-carrier spectral mapping, 3D property mapping, and AI-agentic experiments.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a review of recent advances but reports no quantitative datasets, accuracy metrics, or benchmark comparisons.
watch_item: Imaging throughput must be balanced against accuracy, especially when extracting multiple thermal parameters with high confidence.
paper_title: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
